Shipped forecast-window alerting (AlertWindow: overnight + next 6/12/24h) with pure forecast evaluation path, worker wiring, persistence, and builder UI. Temperature/wind windows cover overnight-low/frost/heat/wind-ahead; precip-probability rules split to just-my-weather-x5p. Verified on device.

Shipped density spectrum: Density enum (Spacious/Comfortable/Compact) persisted in ViewConfig, mapped to hero size + row/section spacing + timestamp visibility via DensitySpec; Customize chip row drives it, HomeScreen reads it. Default unchanged. Verified live on device.

Shipped theming: ThemeConfig (mood system/light/dark, 6 accents, sans/serif/mono) persisted via DataStore alongside ViewConfig; Theme.kt maps it to colorScheme/accent/typeface in one place; ThemeViewModel wraps the app so changes re-theme live; Customize 'Look' section drives it. Defaults match shipped look. Verified on device.

Shipped precip-chance forecast alerts. ForecastPoint+probabilityOfPrecipitation parsed; new sealed AlertSubject (WeatherField | PrecipChance) replaces AlertRule.field — precip is forecast-only (kept out of the view catalog), rides the max-over-window path. Codec back-compat via legacy 'field' key. Builder offers rain only under forecast windows. Verified on device.

Shipped both deferred NWS-port bits. (1) Point cache persisted across process death via a PointCache seam (InMemory default + DataStorePointCache durable, PointCacheCodec); WeatherRepository delegates to it under the resolve mutex; AppContainer wires the durable one. (2) getHourlyForecast now covered for precip-probability + Celsius conversion. Verified on device: force-stop+relaunch persists point_cache and still renders weather.

Periodic alert worker now scheduled only when an enabled rule exists. AlertWorker.sync()/cancel(); AlertsViewModel re-syncs on every edit (onRulesChanged); onCreate schedules only if rules are live. Verified via WorkManager diagnostics: personal-alerts CANCELLED with no rules, ENQUEUED after adding one.

Shipped quiet hours (v1 of tone/frequency): global AlertSettings (quietHoursEnabled + window, isQuietAt wraps midnight) persisted via DataStore; AlertNotifier gained a low-importance silent channel; the worker delivers on it during quiet hours so overnight alerts arrive hushed, not dropped. Alerts screen toggle. Remaining knobs (custom window, per-rule tone/snooze, cadence) split to just-my-weather-pcj/-ken. Verified on device.

Open-source readiness shipped: LICENSE (Apache-2.0, © Raylytics) + NOTICE; README status refreshed to shipped state + License section; CONTRIBUTING.md (gate, conventions, field-keyword trap, licensing); docs/architecture.md (package map + data flow) and docs/extending.md (recipes for adding a data point / alert subject / window / theme accent / density / persisted setting). Screenshots + GitHub templates split to just-my-weather-tfe.

Added mipmap-anydpi/ic_launcher.xml (layer-list of background colour + sun foreground vector) as the pre-26 launcher icon fallback. aapt2 confirms mipmap/ic_launcher packages both anydpi-v21 (fallback for API 24-25) and anydpi-v26 (adaptive icon, 26+). Build + ktlint green.

Added testTagsAsResourceId at the root (MainActivity) + testTags on the customize Switch/reorder controls (toggle_<key>, moveUp/moveDown_<key>), and .maestro/01-customize.yaml toggling Wind on and asserting it appears on home. Verified: 01-customize and 00-smoke both pass on Pixel_7_API_34.

Added docs/screenshots/{glance,customize,alerts}.png (captured at calm defaults) embedded in an 'A look' README section, plus .github/ issue templates (bug + feature) and a PR template (gate checklist + Apache-2.0 note).

Testing & tooling complete: 77 JUnit5/Mockito unit tests, ktlint gate, pre-commit hook (scripts/hooks), Maestro flows (00-smoke + 01-customize), and now CI — .github/workflows/ci.yml runs test+ktlint+assemble on push/PR. Verified the CI run passes green on GitHub (run 28445338043, 5m52s).

Persistence foundation fully delivered: Preferences DataStore backs view config, theme, alert rules, alert settings, and the point cache (all with graceful-degradation codecs — defaulted fields + unknown-key fallback — which serve as the versioned-migration story). Settings live in-context (Customize: density/theme; Alerts: quiet hours) rather than a separate screen, by design. Remaining scope — saved/named locations — split to just-my-weather-xup.

View customization fully delivered: pick/reorder/relabel (ViewConfig, persisted + live), density spectrum (Density + DensitySpec), and theming (ThemeConfig: light/dark/system, accent, typeface). Verified on device, unit-tested.

Configurable polling cadence shipped: AlertSettings.pollMinutes (30m/1h/3h/6h) persisted; AlertWorker.schedule parameterized + uses UPDATE so a cadence change retunes the periodic worker while an unchanged interval keeps its schedule; 'Check every' chip row on the Alerts screen. Verified on device: chips persist across relaunch and the worker stays ENQUEUED through the retune.
Decided by Evan: option 4 — bundled US Census Gazetteer place list (offline search, public domain) + raw lat/lon entry as escape hatch. No external geocoder.

Evan flipped visibility to public (verified via gh: PUBLIC). Branch protection intentionally skipped for now — required PRs/status checks would block the direct-to-main push workflow; revisit when outside contributors arrive.

Verified end-to-end on a Pixel 7 API 34 emulator (Play image, Android 14). (1) Loud path: always-true rule (Temperature below 200) added via UI fired the runOnce worker → notification on channel personal_alerts (importance DEFAULT), text 'Temperature is 83°, below your 200°'. (2) Quiet hours: device timezone shifted to 22:51 local via cmd alarm set-timezone, quiet toggle enabled, rule re-added → notification delivered on personal_alerts_quiet (importance LOW, no sound/vibration). (3) Denied POST_NOTIFICATIONS: pm revoke + relaunch → AlertWorker ran to SUCCESS, zero notifications posted, no crash; entering Alerts correctly re-prompts the system permission dialog, and declining leaves the screen fully functional. (4) Periodic schedule: WorkManager job registered in JobScheduler with TIMING_DELAY+CONNECTIVITY constraints, present again after emulator reboot. Not covered (needs a physical device over days): real Doze/battery-optimization deferral of the periodic tick.

Fixed in 90639d7, shipped as v0.1.1 (https://github.com/jimbottle/just-my-weather/releases/tag/v0.1.1). Root cause: targetSdk 35 → Android 15+ enforces edge-to-edge; no screen padded for system-bar insets. Fix at the one root seam in MainActivity: enableEdgeToEdge() + theme-background paint across the full window + safeDrawingPadding on the root Box. Verified by screenshots on a new Android 15 emulator (Pixel_7_API_35, google_apis image — installed cmdline-tools + image for this, AVD hand-created since no avdmanager exists): title clear of status bar, bottom chips clear of gesture nav, on Home and Customize (top+bottom). v0.1.1 installed on Evan's Pixel 9 (versionName confirmed 0.1.1). The API 34-only emulator gap that let this ship is recorded in bd memory stack-and-gotchas.

Shipped in a7afb79. Mode chips (Now/Hourly/Daily) on the home glance in a horizontally scrolling row; Hourly renders hour tiles (time, temp, precip%) and Daily renders NWS half-day period tiles (name, high/low with the low dimmed, short forecast), both as horizontally scrolling strips. Default framing set in Customize ('Opens on'), persisted in ViewConfig with codec round-trip + legacy-config tests; NwsClient.getDailyForecast added with parse test (85 tests total, gate green). Verified all three modes live on the Android 15 emulator with real NWS data; caught and fixed an init-order NPE (forecastMutex declared after the init block that used it) during device verification. Installed on Evan's Pixel 9.

Shipped in c4f87c5. Daily condenses day/night half-periods into one high/low tile per day (new default) via pure combineDays; Customize gained a 'Daily view' section with style (High & low / Day & night) and layout (Side by side / Stacked) chips, persisted in ViewConfig with codec round-trip + legacy-fallback tests. Hourly strip shows accent FRI/Jul-31 date markers at local-midnight boundaries via pure groupHoursByDay (timezone passed in, no clock reads), on by default. 97 tests green. Verified all three on the Android 15 emulator with live NWS data (screenshots: date-grouped hourly, combined tiles, stacked week list); installed on Evan's Pixel 9.

Shipped in 1f5fbeb. Now hero always renders above the selected framing (NOW mode = hero only); ViewMode.DEFAULT changed to HOURLY (fresh install verified: hero + date-grouped hourly strip). Hourly gained Stacked layout — date section headers + time/precip/temp rows — via hourlyLayout: ForecastLayout (DailyLayout generalised, persistence keys unchanged), Customize gained an 'Hourly view' section and its options now scroll with the page. Bonus from Evan mid-turn: accent chips paint their selected background with the real accent colour (luminance-flipped label). 101 tests green; verified fresh-install default, stacked hourly, and Amber swatch on the Android 15 emulator; installed on the Pixel 9. NOTE: verification was interrupted by another agent session installing io.raylytics.basicdo onto this project's emulator AND Evan's Pixel (installDebug fan-out) — flagged via handoff.

Shipped: CI now runs the Maestro suite on an API 35 emulator (reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner) as a separate job from the fast gate, continue-on-error since the flows hit the live NWS API. Added .maestro/02-alerts.yaml covering the highest-state screen (build rule, toggle, quiet hours, remove, return), which required the testTags noted in this issue — quietHours/toggleRule/removeRule/thresholdValue/addRule on AlertsScreen. 3/3 flows pass locally in 43s and BOTH CI jobs passed on the first run (run 30720221115). Two findings recorded in CLAUDE.md: entering Alerts triggers the POST_NOTIFICATIONS dialog that launchApp's blanket grant doesn't cover and clearState doesn't reliably reset (flow settles then taps it optionally, tolerating both), and Maestro ignores ANDROID_SERIAL — it silently ran the suite against another session's emulator on an older build, reporting the new testTags as missing; use 'maestro --device <serial>'. A follow-up commit pinning the Maestro installer version, pinning the emulator-runner action to a SHA, and scoping GITHUB_TOKEN to contents:read is committed but UNPUSHED pending ssh key re-add.
